decisions.statement: A panel is fetched by the address the game names it under.
The code fetched is what the landing wrote, not what the author wrote.
What the app offers is laid out before any panel's code is run.
A panel whose code offers no panel is left out rather than shown empty.
The panels come back in the order the game names them.
Nothing here is bundled with the app, so a new panel needs no deploy.

definition: the panels a game names, fetched as code and made ready to be shown
